sloka: तव चैव महाभागे विदितं मम तत्त्वतः ।सर्वं च विदितं मह्यं त्रैलोक्ये यद्धि वर्तते ।। ७.४९.१३ ॥
transliteration: tava caiva mahābhāge viditaṁ mama tattvataḥ ।sarvaṁ ca viditaṁ mahyaṁ trailokye yaddhi vartate ।। 7.49.13 ॥

translations.english: O highly fortunate one, your true nature is indeed known to me, and everything that exists in the three worlds is also known to me.
